text:
alice.lewis: Deploy finished to prod-1. Kicked off a focused smokeburst (timebox 20m). @deploy-bot start probes and post quick stats. runbook/link ready -> https://redwood.local/runbooks/post-deploy-checks :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release=2026.3.1, cohort=prod-1, nodes=84, duration=2m34s. smokeburst started. logs -> https://deploy.logs/3123456789
ben.kim: Running quick KV synth and short chatgen probe now. hitting /health and /v1/generate with 20 short prompts.
ben.kim: curl check I ran:
```
curl -sS https://prod-1.api.redwood/v1/health | jq '.'
{
  "ok": true,
  "serving_nodes": 84
}
```
ben.kim: Results after 5m: kv-synth p50=32ms p95=210ms (baseline p95=150ms). chatgen p95=420ms (baseline 380ms). small bump in us-west-1 p95s.
serena: Observing embed route (eu-west-1) 429 spike: ~2.7% 429s over last 5m, baseline ~0.2%. Queue depth high on pod-3 (node-id kube-eu-3).
ops-sre: Confirmed: HPA scaling events delayed, lots of short-lived queue spikes. Seeing kube events: "BackOff" on kube-eu-3 container restart loop around the time of deploy. Pulling events and node metrics.
ben.kim: Re-ran probe after bumping concurrency limits on app -> kv p95 back to 190ms, chatgen p95 390ms. eu embed still noisy though.
alice.lewis: Decision: hold rollout ramp and pin this variant only to prod-1. No rollback yet. Increase synthetic sampling to 5x for next 30m. @pm-jordan FYI. :pause_button:
pm-jordan: No customer reports so far, good to hold. What are concrete rollback criteria?
serena: Proposed rollback criteria: combined 5xx+429 > 3% sustained for 15m OR embed p95 > 400ms for 10m. Otherwise keep on hold and let ops attempt recovery.
ops-sre: Taking action: manual recreate of kube-eu-3 pod in 30s, temporarily tightening autoscaler thresholds (targetCPU 25% -> 15%) while we watch. Will post events.
deploy-bot: Traffic ramp paused at 45%. Pin applied: variant=v2026.3.1 -> prod-1 only. Synthetic sampling increased. Alert created -> #inc-keeper-31234.
ben.kim: After autoscale tweak: eu embed 429s dropped to 0.6%, p95=210ms. kv and chat paths stable. We'll continue to monitor for 15m and then decide whether to resume ramp.
alice.lewis: Thanks all. Action items: ops-sre monitor autoscaler + node health, ben keep probes running every 2m, serena validate embed queue depth and logs, I'll update release notes + hold flag. Reconvene T+30m for go/no-go.
ops-sre: Ack. Opening incident runbook if thresholds breach. :eyes: 
ben.kim: :thumbsup: will post final metrics at T+15m and T+30m.
